# Gayduo Management Agency

> Gayduo Management Agency is a talent management agency that connects talent with brands. We represent individuals across sports, lifestyle, and campus culture — including footballers and basketball players — and build the commercial partnerships that deliver value for both sides.

## About

- [Who We Are](https://gayduoma.com/about): Our mission, approach, and positioning as a talent management agency.
- [Services](https://gayduoma.com/services): Contract negotiation, transfer guidance, commercial deals, media & broadcast, social strategy, public relations, content production, and philanthropy.
- [Our Team](https://gayduoma.com/team): The management team behind the agency.
- [Contact](https://gayduoma.com/contact): Get in touch for representation, partnership, brand, or media inquiries.

## Talent

- [Athletes](https://gayduoma.com/talent): The roster of athletes we represent, with individual profiles, stats, and career history.

## News

- [Blog](https://gayduoma.com/blog): News, transfers, and features on our athletes and the agency.

## Offices

Kigali, Rwanda · Monrovia, Liberia
